chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with proteinuria and hypertension, currently awaiting kidney transplantation.
history_of_present_illness: The patient first developed essential hypertension, stage 2 chronic kidney disease, microalbuminuria and diabetic kidney disease in July 1991. Over the next few years the renal disease progressed to stage 3 CKD and overt proteinuria by October 1993. By January 1999 CKD advanced to stage 4, and in February 1999 the patient was placed on the kidney transplant waiting list. Obesity (BMI >30) was documented in 1992 and chronic sinusitis has been present since 1987. The patient is currently managed with low‑dose lisinopril and amlodipine, with no documented antidiabetic, lipid‑lowering, or anemia therapies. Recent visits are few, with limited outpatient follow‑up and missing recent vital‑sign and laboratory data.
